svg.text: K4'S TWO MARKS: DOUBLED LETTERS BY COLUMN OF 7, AND PAIRS 21 APART THAT REPEAT
Five of six in column 4; the test asks for at
least four doublets with at most one outside
Rows of 21: a letter and the one below it form a pair. 11
pairs repeat one seen earlier (LS, BS, LW, IT, QZ, KK, WA, SN,
ZT, AZ, PK); accent marks their cells.
The test asks for 11 or more.
